status.zh: 招新安排及报名状态请以官方微信公众号最新通知为准。
status.en: See the official WeChat account for current recruitment dates and application status.

about.zh: 为同学争取专属福利，为商家拓展校园市场。市场部连接学生与品牌，将合作机会变成校园生活中的实际收获。
about.en: We connect students with brands, securing student benefits and helping businesses reach the campus community.

about.zh: 从餐饮、娱乐到教育、科技，我们洽谈商家合作、策划线下讲座，并为学联活动争取赞助，让同学接触更多职业与学习资源。
about.en: From dining and entertainment to education and technology, we build partnerships, organise talks and seek event sponsorship, bringing students closer to career and learning resources.

about.zh: 想尝试商务拓展、品牌运营或创意推广？带上热情与行动力，和我们一起创造更多可能。
about.en: Interested in partnerships, brand communication or creative promotion? Bring your enthusiasm and initiative, and build something with us.

quote.zh: 启程的意义不在于终点；而在于每一步都在超越昨天的自己。勇敢迈出第一步的人，先享受世界～欢迎你们加入MCSA市场部大家庭！
quote.en: The journey is about growing beyond who you were yesterday with every step. Take that first brave step and enjoy what the world offers. Welcome to the MCSA Marketing family!

quote.zh: 新的学期，我们对内组的宗旨就是：在文字里找到热爱，在对接中收获成长！在这里，你不用怕从零开始：有人带你写文案、练排版，有人教你做对接、学沟通，不管你是社牛还是社恐，不管你是大佬还是小白，市场部对内组都有你的位置。我们要的不是完美，而是愿意一起玩耍、一起学习的你！新学期，市场部对内组，等你入伙，一起“搞事情”！
quote.en: Our aim is to find joy in writing and grow through collaboration. You can start from scratch: teammates will help you write copy, practise layouts, coordinate projects and communicate. Whether outgoing or quiet, experienced or new, there is a place for you. We welcome people who want to learn and have fun together. Join us and make things happen!

quote.zh: 在MCSA市场部这个温暖的大家庭里，你可以收获有实战谈判的历练，也可以交到志同道合的朋友们，更可以发现一个全新的自己～期待同频的你，和我们一起学习成长，玩转市场，共赴热爱！
quote.en: In our welcoming team, you can gain practical negotiation experience, meet like-minded friends and discover new sides of yourself. Join us to learn, grow and explore marketing together!

historyNote.zh: 部长团队 · 根据本次提供的招新资料整理。
historyNote.en: Leadership team featured in the supplied recruitment material.

tagline.zh: 建立合作，把资源带到同学身边。
tagline.en: Build partnerships that bring opportunities to students.

duties.zh: 与餐饮、娱乐、教育、科技等行业商家沟通，洽谈学生专属优惠与折扣。
duties.en: Approach businesses in dining, entertainment, education and technology to negotiate student offers.

duties.zh: 策划线下讲座，为同学连接职业与学习资源。
duties.en: Plan in-person talks that connect students with career and learning resources.

duties.zh: 为学联活动争取赞助，并维护长期合作关系。
duties.en: Seek sponsorship for MCSA events and maintain lasting partnerships.

requirements.zh: 主动参加推广活动，积极拓展商家资源。
requirements.en: Take initiative, participate regularly in promotional activities and develop business contacts.

requirements.zh: 清晰表达合作价值，与商家建立长期关系。
requirements.en: Communicate partnership value clearly and build long-term relationships.

requirements.zh: 理解商家需求，提出互利共赢的合作方案。
requirements.en: Understand business needs and propose mutually beneficial partnerships.

requirements.zh: 面对拒绝不气馁，持续尝试并优化策略。
requirements.en: Stay resilient when facing rejection, and keep refining your approach.

requirements.zh: 与其他部门协作，提高合作执行力。
requirements.en: Work with other departments to deliver partnerships effectively.

tagline.zh: 用文案、社交媒体与视觉内容，让福利被看见。
tagline.en: Make student benefits visible through words, social media and design.

duties.zh: 撰写推广推文与广告文案，提升学联及合作商家的曝光。
duties.en: Write promotional articles and advertising copy for MCSA and its partners.

duties.zh: 结合校园生活与热点，策划有趣的营销活动。
duties.en: Develop engaging campaigns around campus life and relevant trends.

duties.zh: 设计海报、视频等视觉内容，让推广更有吸引力。
duties.en: Create posters, videos and other visual content that makes promotions engaging.

requirements.zh: 具备文字表达能力，能撰写吸引人的推文和广告文案。
requirements.en: Write engaging articles and advertising copy.

requirements.zh: 善于捕捉热点，思维灵活，能结合校园生活策划内容。
requirements.en: Spot relevant trends and develop creative content connected to campus life.

requirements.zh: 了解微信公众号、小红书、Instagram等社交媒体平台。
requirements.en: Understand platforms such as WeChat, Xiaohongshu and Instagram.

requirements.zh: 具备基本设计或排版能力是加分项，例如使用Canva、Photoshop。
requirements.en: Basic design or layout skills, including Canva or Photoshop, are a plus.

requirements.zh: 关注数据反馈，分析推广效果，持续优化内容策略。
requirements.en: Use feedback and performance data to improve content strategy.

text.zh: 接触各行业商家，为同学争取专属福利。
text.en: Meet businesses across industries and help secure student benefits.

text.zh: 学习谈判、商务合作与市场推广，培养商业思维。
text.en: Develop negotiation, partnership and promotion skills through practice.

text.zh: 结识合作商家，与学联核心团队共同推进项目。
text.en: Build connections with businesses and collaborate with the MCSA core team.

text.zh: 在高效协作中结交朋友，让每一份努力被看见。
text.en: Make friends through collaborative work and have your contributions recognised.

welcome.zh: 可以没有经验，但要积极主动、有责任心，愿意付诸行动。
welcome.en: Experience is not essential. Initiative, responsibility and a willingness to act matter.

welcome.zh: 谈判、设计、营销文案都可以从零开始学习。带上基本的审美、表达能力，以及勇敢尝试的心。
welcome.en: Negotiation, design and marketing writing can all be learned. Bring an eye for presentation, communication skills and the courage to try.

application.zh: 查看官方招新推文，按文中指引添加小助手并发送“市场部”，了解后续面试信息。
application.en: Open the official recruitment post and follow its instructions to add an assistant on WeChat. Send “市场部” to ask about interview information.
